item: Row C: places and Wikidata items ride backups; place types translated (R71 b, Q823 a)
summary: A restore carries places and wikidata_items; a contradicting row is kept beside the local one (oo.prov/1 tags, keep/discard), the local row never gives way, OSM credit via OSM_DERIVED_TABLES. merged_rows.row_key finds text-keyed arrivals by natural key because VACUUM may renumber rowids; provenance_tag ignores an arrival a local job re-stamped. Place.kind shown in the interface language x12 (ooPlaceKind). Stale never-leaves-the-machine statements corrected. Non-English words AI-drafted, want a native check.
